title: Hotels
body:
Official Hotel Room Blocks

We've negotiated discount rates with two hotels adjacent to Le Palais des Congrès (Summit venue). Please move quickly to reserve a room before they sell out!

  • Le Meridien Etoile
  • Hyatt Regency Etoile 

Other Nearby Hotel/Rental Options

In addition to the official room blocks, we've identified several hotels located in close proximity to Le Palais des Congrès. We will NOT secure room blocks with these hotels, but they may be great options for your stay in Paris.

Note: The Porte Maillot metro stop on Line 1 is located in Le Palais des Congrès building. If you stay at a hotel or apartment located on the metro line you will be able to easily access the Summit. 

  • List of Nearby Hotels 
  • Ammenities included at the Nearby Hotels listed

If you plan to bring your family with you to Paris or if you would like to have more space than a hotel room offers then you may want to rent an apartment or condo during your stay. The following sites are recommended for short-term property rentals.

  • VRBO
  • Airbnb
  • HomeAway
